name: e0-planner-fixture-v2
note: Pinned with v1's hashes (E0 card Amendment 1): the same exposed r3 index of e0-r3/run-5, the same stage brief, source ids, chunk count and extraction budget, so v1 and its run record stay as they are. The conditions are the plan call the committed serving card would send if adopted as written (its decision is still proposed): legacy-thinking-structured (the strict research_plan response_format item 9 sends, thinking on, 8,192 tokens) and the same call at 16,384 tokens, legacy-thinking-structured-16384, a calibration cell a card cannot send until P10 measures plan at 16,384. legacy-thinking, the plan call without a card, is the control within the run. 10 repeats, 30 calls, each repeat running the three conditions in turn; the command line takes the conditions and the repeats from this manifest. With --cache-salt every body carries the fixture's one salt, as a run under the card carries one; v1 ran without it. Endpoint time, from v1's run on this index (BL-20261116-1019: 30 calls in 22 minutes, thinking-on calls 26 to 73 s, about 112 to 130 completion tokens/s): a reply that runs to its cap takes about 73 s at 8,192 tokens and about 146 s at 16,384, so about 30 to 40 minutes as v1's replies ran, and about 50 minutes if every reply runs to its cap. Proposed by BL-20261116-1253-e0-planner-structured-condition-design; the E0 card's amendment names the command before the run.
